escape_misc option escapes miscellaneous markdown characters

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Use # and | and ~ in text.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(escape_misc: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
